utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with a small task, as long as it stays pretty low-key this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That works — could you check which locations still need supplies and note any repair priorities?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m here—what’s the first thing you want me to handle for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still set for Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good — I’ll pass the word along and help keep the repair drive on track.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Quinn — let’s keep the first update simple: Sunday at the community center. I’ll line up the next steps from there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to take the simplest task off your hands—just point me to what’s easiest for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Jules — could you help me sort the donation updates into a simple list? That’d keep me from losing the thread.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great—just send me the locations when you have them, and I’ll keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, I’ll pass along the locations as soon as I have them — folks are still gathering donations and pinning down the biggest fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like folks are still sorting donations and the top fixes, so I can pass along any updates I hear. Just tell me what you need first for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Nell — just send me the donation updates first, then the top fixes. Keep it simple and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I can check what we’ve got left and make a quick needs list. Just tell me what’s most needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check what’s running low first and send you a quick list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m here now—what still needs doing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — if we can keep it to a short, practical list and a clear time, I can stay on top of the logistics.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Opal, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes—we’re still on for this weekend, and I’ll keep it organized once you send the locations.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, the repair drive is still on, right? Just tell me what time and what I should bring.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep—let’s make it simple: meet at 10 AM, and please bring gloves and a hammer if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m here now—what’s the next thing you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah — I’ll keep it simple and spread the repair drive update at the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I can keep lending tools and help check what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Gus — that really helps. What time this weekend were you thinking?
